description: Return Vietnam's regional minimum wages (monthly and hourly, regions I-IV) in force on a date from January 2026, including the new rates from 1 January 2027, with the unemployment insurance ceiling of each region (20 x the minimum). The region of a workplace is set by the decree's annex of communes; this tool does not look it up. Examples: {}; {"as_of":"2027-02","region":"I"}.

as_of.description: Date of the calculation: YYYY-MM (first day of that month) or YYYY-MM-DD. Default: today in Vietnam. Supported from 2026-01; earlier dates are rejected.

date.description: Synonym of as_of (same formats: YYYY-MM or YYYY-MM-DD). Pass only one of as_of, month, date.

month.description: Synonym of as_of (same formats: YYYY-MM or YYYY-MM-DD). Pass only one of as_of, month, date.

region.description: Optional region I-IV (or 1-4) to single out; all four regions are always listed.

name: minimum_wage
title: Regional minimum wage (Vietnam)
